name: browser-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.4 server for Playwright browser automation - browse, click, screenshot, extract, plus cross-browser bookmarks and agentic workflows

tools.name: browse_page
tools.description: Navigate to a URL and extract visible text

tools.name: click_element
tools.description: Click an element by CSS selector

tools.name: extract_text
tools.description: Extract inner text from a CSS selector

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a PNG screenshot of the viewport

tools.name: fill_input
tools.description: Type text into an input field

tools.name: close_browser
tools.description: Close the browser and release resources

tools.name: browser_bookmarks
tools.description: Bookmark CRUD/search/sync across Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave

tools.name: browser_agent
tools.description: Agentic browsing with an LLM via browser-use

tools.name: browse_items
tools.description: Browse a list of links with structured summaries

tools.name: browse_workflow
tools.description: Multi-step agentic browsing from a task
